root_cause: A traffic spike at 03:00 (about 3.3 times normal) made the autoscaler grow orders-api from 4 to 12 replicas. Each replica opens up to 25 database connections, 300 in total, but pg-proxy accepts 200 client connections, so the new replicas waited for connections and requests timed out. The database itself stayed healthy (CPU about 50%).
